title: When a phone pop-up cannot be queued, nobody is told
what: When the gym sends a message or offer, a trainer replies to a question, or the desk decides a plan request, report request or shop order, the server queues a phone pop-up for the member. If queuing that pop-up fails, the gym's own action still goes through (on purpose), but the failure is only written as a warning in the database's own log. The owner still sees the message as sent, the member never gets the pop-up, and nothing alerts HQ, so a run of failures would go unnoticed until members complain.
expected: A pop-up that could not be queued leaves a mark HQ looks at (a failed-jobs count or an alert), so a broken pop-up path is noticed the same day.
how_often: rarely, only when queuing a pop-up fails
fix_line: Record each pop-up that could not be queued where HQ already looks, and count them on the HQ health view
